targets.artifact: The library and the `oneagentgraph` binary, as a Rust dependent takes them.
The per-platform wheels that put the `oneagentgraph` binary on PATH for `pip install`.
The launcher that resolves and execs the prebuilt binary for `npm install -g`.

covers.why: The per-platform packages exist only so this launcher can resolve one at its own exact version. Nothing depends on one by name, so none is a target of its own; a consumer waits on the launcher.
